messages.en:

{09 01 00}{09 08 00}{07 00 00}Kuule, {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}, kas sa oled
lugenud {07 0b 00}viimast numbrit

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{09 06 00}{07 16 00}Why would I care about some
stupid mop? {01 00 00 05 00}I am, like, SO
not into cleaning.
You can have your mop. {01 00 00 05 00}{07 13 00}I've
got candy. So why don't you
just go scrub something?{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{09 06 00}{07 16 00}Miks peaks mind huvitama
mingi rumal mopp? {01 00 00 05 00}Ma pole
üldse koristamise lainel.
Jäta oma mopp endale. {01 00 00 05 00}{07 13 00}Mul
on komme. Nii et mine ja
küüri midagi!{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 03 00}Well, duh! What else would
you use it for?{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 03 00}No muidugi! Milleks sa seda
veel kasutaksid?{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 01 00}Hey, don't call Moppina an
it! She's a she, and she's
my best friend ever!
{07 14 00}Moppina lets me try out new
hairstyles on her, so I can
see how they'd look.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
{07 13 00}And she tries on clothes
for me and lets me
dance with her.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
And SHE actually {07 01 00}LISTENS
to me, unlike just about
everyone else in this town!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 01 00}Hei, ära nimeta Moppinat
selleks! Ta on tema ja mu
parim sõber üldse!
{07 14 00}Moppina laseb mul enda peal
uusi soenguid proovida, et
ma näeksin, kuidas sobib.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
{07 13 00}Ja ta proovib minu jaoks
riideid ja laseb mul
endaga tantsida.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
Ja TEMA tegelikult {07 01 00}KUULAB
mind, erinevalt peaaegu
kõigist teistest siin linnas!{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 14 00}Oh, of course! You can come
over anytime. {09 02 00}{07 13 00}{09 01 00}We'll have
tea and cookies!
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 14 00}Oh, muidugi! Sa võid tulla
millal tahes. {09 02 00}{07 13 00}{09 01 00}Meil on
teed ja küpsiseid!

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}Yeah, but I don't-- {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0c 00}Oh!{01 00 00 0f 00}
I think I see where you're
going with this now.
{07 19 00}Oh, that's good. {01 00 00 05 00}That's
really good.

{07 0e 00}I bet you could do all sorts
of damage {07 14 00}if you had a pair
of those on!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}Jah, aga ma ei-- {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0c 00}Oh!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Ma vist näen nüüd, kuhu
sa sellega jõuad.
{07 19 00}Oh, see on hea. {01 00 00 05 00}See on
tõesti hea.

{07 0e 00}Vean kihla, et sa suudaksid
palju kahju teha, {07 14 00}kui sul
oleks paar sellist jalas!{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{09 06 00}Oh, that's easy. Carrot.{01 01 00}
What, did you think I wasn't
going to have an answer?
Dude, I think about this
ALL THE TIME. {07 14 00}I'd have a
delicious frosting hat.
{07 13 00}And I could eat it whenever

sugar got too low.{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{09 06 00}Oh, see on lihtne. Porgand.{01 01 00}

mul pole vastust?
Kulla mees, ma mõtlen selle
peale KOGU AEG. {07 14 00}Mul oleks
maitsev glasuurmüts.
{07 13 00}Ja ma võiksin seda süüa,
kui mul kõht tühi on või
veresuhkur liiga madal.{09 09 00}

messages.en:
